name: Light Painting Shutter
promptTemplate: Long-exposure performance in {{light_palette}} light tracing {{calligraphy_style}} ribbons with persistence {{trail_persistence}} and stroke thickness {{ribbon_width}} at {{speed}} speed with embers {{sparkles}}.

ui.title: LIGHT SHUTTER +6
ui.tagline: Long-exposure torch calligraphy across the void

light_palette.hint: Changes ribbon spectrum and glow colors

trail_persistence.hint: Higher values keep old strokes burning longer

ribbon_width.hint: Expands luminous core and halo thickness

sparkles.hint: Sheds embers and falling spark particles

listing.blurb: A luminous torch carves glowing loops and knots into deep blackness, leaving radiant lingering ribbons while spectators steer satellites around the flame.
listing.prompt: Long-exposure light painting: an unseen performer's torch draws loops, spirals and signatures in the dark, each stroke staying as a glowing trail that slowly fades, like a camera shutter left open. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
